title: An older reader and a newer journal
situation: The concept journal is append-only and travels with the repository, but the runtime that reads it refuses any entry kind it does not know: a journal holding one classify entry is unreadable to every runtime built before classify, so a host, a teammate or an earlier branch's build stops being able to reconstitute. Event-sourced systems normally keep old readers working (a tolerant reader that skips what it does not know, or versioned entries).
decision: Settle how a runtime treats an entry kind it does not know: refuse, as now; or read past it, reporting that the journal holds entries this runtime cannot interpret and that its views may be incomplete.
consequences: Belongs to the delivery cut, with upgrade (0029).
